rules: The fixed seven-stage agreement controls. No stage advances before independent acceptance.
Complete means the stated activity has evidence. It does not close its stage or establish enterprise readiness.
A failure reopens its stage. Never weaken a valid assertion, threshold or expected answer.
Fresh cohorts materially exercise each feature. Minimum ten fresh projects per family; failed and previously used projects are regression-only.
Independent inputs and answers must not be derived from CMeng. Internal generated testing is not independent real-project acceptance.
Preserve original source files, hashes, revisions, authority and project isolation. Missing and quarantined values are not authoritative zeros.
CMeng must work without paid AI. No project-specific product logic.
Completion dates are recorded only after evidence is captured. Unscheduled dates are not promises.
